purpose: Cross-harness seam that requires repository-backed actions to resolve canonical development/use/worktree/entrypoint roles and keep remote, checkout, use-path, and entrypoint proof states independent. Machine/profile-specific path resolution remains owned by the registered profile owner; P92 owns deep repair/audit.

requiredBefore: local validator, build, generator, launcher, updater, or deployment-helper invocation
local artifact generation whose correctness depends on repository state
operator handoff that tells a workstation to run a repository-owned command

exemptions.condition: The action reads remote/provider metadata only and makes no claim about a local checkout, production/use path, or operator entrypoint.
exemptions.mustRecord: canonical path proof is not applicable to this action because no local repository-backed action occurs

exemptions.condition: The action only inspects already-addressed source evidence and performs no local invocation or local-adoption claim.
exemptions.mustRecord: canonical path proof deferred until the first local repository-backed action

requiredRoles.meaning: The one mutable canonical checkout used for normal development for the selected machine/profile.
The path from which the application or repository-owned operator commands are actually used/served/installed for the selected machine/profile.
The approved root for isolated parallel/proof worktrees; not a second mutable canonical clone.
The actual launcher/command surfaced to the operator for the requested action.

windowsTechnicianProfile.deepRepairNote: P92/PR #149 owns stronger Windows candidate classification, NONCANONICAL_PRESERVE behavior, emitted pathRoles, and launcher enforcement. P01 must not fork that owner.

proofStates.proof: Refreshed provider/Git evidence shows the integration SHA is contained in the actual remote default branch.
The resolved canonical development checkout was inspected after refresh and contains the required integration/content floor.
The resolved production/use path is the expected canonical path (or has an explicit N/A relation) and contains/uses the required integration floor.
The resolved real operator entrypoint was actually invoked or observed against the current production/use path and produced the requested bounded receipt/result.
doesNotImply: higher runtime, provider, deployment, or user-visible acceptance

consumerRequirement: Every app/profile harness must resolve all four requiredRoles through its canonical profile/path owner or record a role-specific notApplicableReason. Launchers, updaters, worktree helpers, status reporters, and operator handoffs must consume that owner rather than inventing paths.
proofCeiling: Repository contract and hosted/static seam proof only. It does not prove a particular physical workstation path, local fast-forward, installed/use path, or entrypoint execution until that proof state is observed there.
